dedupe_keys.name: fusionierte punktwolken der schleuse koblenz 6 epochen im zeitraum juni 2023 bis oktober 2024 und fusionierte punktwolken der bahnbrucke koblenz lutzel 4 epochen im zeitraum september 2023 bis oktober 2024

description: Fusionierte Punktwolken der Schleuse Koblenz (6 Epochen im Zeitraum Juni 2023 bis Oktober 2024) und Fusionierte Punktwolken der Bahnbrücke Koblenz-Lützel (4 Epochen im Zeitraum September 2023 bis Oktober 2024) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by doi.org. The point clouds provided were included as a data basis in the BMDV expert network (work package 10 ‘Multitemporal status recording, model development and change analysis of transport infrastructure structures’ in topic 3). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Merged point clouds of the Koblenz lock (6 epochs in the period from June 2023 to October 2024) and Merged point clouds " (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Brücke, Fächerecholot, Schleuse, opendata, Punktwolke, Laserscanning. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
